zh.title: 瑞安航空宣佈冬季削減比利時20條航線並撤出6架飛機
zh.summary: 瑞安航空將於2026年冬季削減比利時20條航線並撤出6架飛機。
body: 瑞安航空表示，已於2026年10月20日宣佈，將在即將到來的2026年冬季大幅縮減比利時業務。公司計畫取消20條航線，整個冬季季節共涉及110萬個座位，並將6架飛機從目前設於比利時的基地撤出，重新部署至其他地區。
瑞安航空表示，此舉是為抗議比利時航空稅調升。該稅額預定於2027年1月從2歐元提高至7歐元。瑞安航空的新聞稿未列出具體取消航線名單。

en.title: Ryanair to cut 20 Belgian routes and remove six aircraft for Winter 2026
en.summary: Ryanair announced 20 Belgian route cuts and removal of six aircraft for Winter 2026.
body: Ryanair said on October 20, 2026, that it will significantly reduce its activity in Belgium during the forthcoming Winter 2026 season. The airline plans to cut 20 routes, accounting for 1.1 million seats across the season, and remove six aircraft from its current Belgian bases for redeployment elsewhere.

Ryanair said it was protesting an increase in Belgium’s aviation tax. The tax is set to rise from €2 to €7 in January 2027. Ryanair’s press release did not provide a specific list of the routes to be cut.

zh.title: BETA Technologies獲FAA特別適航證 可搭載客戶與合作夥伴飛行
zh.summary: BETA Technologies獲FAA特別適航證，並於同日完成首趟相關飛行
body: 聯邦航空總署（FAA）向 BETA Technologies 頒發市場調查用途的特別適航證，允許該公司以 ALIA VTOL A250 載運客戶與合作夥伴飛行。公司於2026年10月20日宣佈獲得授權，並在同一天稍早依新監管資格完成首趟飛行。
該次飛行由 Plattsburgh International Airport（PBG）起飛，前往 Patrick Leahy Burlington International Airport（BTV）；兩地相距34海里，飛行歷時20分鐘。A250在途中完成由垂直飛行轉為翼載飛行，並於降落前再次轉回垂直飛行。

en.title: BETA Technologies receives FAA certificate to fly customers on ALIA eVTOL
en.summary: BETA Technologies receives FAA authorization and completes its first flight under the status.
body: The Federal Aviation Administration (FAA) granted BETA Technologies a Special Airworthiness Certificate for market surveys, enabling the company to fly customers and partners on its ALIA VTOL A250 aircraft. BETA Technologies announced the authorization on October 20, 2026, after completing its first flight under the new regulatory status earlier that day.

The flight went from Plattsburgh International Airport (PBG), New York, to Patrick Leahy Burlington International Airport (BTV), Vermont, a distance of 34 nautical miles. The journey took 20 minutes. During the flight, the A250 transitioned from vertical to wing-borne flight and then returned to vertical flight for landing.

zh.title: Civil Air Patrol訂購21架塞斯納飛機支援搜救與青年任務
zh.summary: Civil Air Patrol訂購21架塞斯納飛機，支援搜救、救災及青年計畫
body: Civil Air Patrol（CAP）向Textron Aviation訂購21架新製塞斯納活塞飛機，供搜救、災害應變、訓練及青年計畫使用，任務範圍遍及美國。Textron Aviation於2026年10月21日公佈訂單，預計在2027年完成交付。
訂單包括7架Cessna Skyhawk 172、11架Cessna Skylane 182、2架Cessna Turbo Skylane T182T，以及1架Cessna Turbo Stationair HD 206。這些飛機將在Textron Aviation位於堪薩斯州Independence的廠區製造。
CAP表示，自2024年10月以來，該組織已飛行近20萬小時，執行860次搜救任務並救出104人。上述數字為CAP提供的統計。

en.title: Civil Air Patrol orders 21 Cessna aircraft for mission support
en.summary: Civil Air Patrol ordered 21 Cessna aircraft for search, disaster response and youth programs.
body: Civil Air Patrol (CAP) has ordered 21 new Cessna piston aircraft from Textron Aviation. The aircraft are intended to support search and rescue, disaster response, training and youth programs across the United States. Textron Aviation announced the order on October 21, 2026, and expects to complete deliveries during 2027.

The order comprises seven Cessna Skyhawk 172s, 11 Cessna Skylane 182s, two Cessna Turbo Skylane T182Ts and one Cessna Turbo Stationair HD 206. Textron Aviation says the aircraft will be built at its facility in Independence, Kansas.
CAP said that since October 2024 it has flown nearly 200,000 hours, carried out 860 search and rescue missions and saved 104 lives. Those figures are attributed to the organization.

zh.title: 勞斯萊斯擴大CorporateCare Enhanced保障，維持計畫每小時費率
zh.summary: 勞斯萊斯擴大引擎維護保障，新增輕微異物損傷及零件退運費用
body: 勞斯萊斯表示，企業飛機引擎維護計畫CorporateCare Enhanced將擴大保障，新增輕微異物損傷、零件退運及其他費用。公司在拉斯維加斯舉行的NBAA-BACE 2026宣佈這些調整，並表示不會提高計畫每小時費率。客戶依飛行時數繳納計畫費用，將涵蓋的引擎維護成本分攤到一段時間內，而非等到需要維修時支付大筆費用。
輕微異物損傷若不需要立即拆下引擎或短艙，且可在機翼上或機翼附近修復，便納入保障；重大異物損傷仍不在保障範圍，相關索賠將透過保險處理。符合資格的Pearl引擎客戶，其壽命限制零件到達規定時限時也可獲得保障。勞斯萊斯並將支付零件退運費用，且正在開發使用預付標籤的退運流程。

en.title: Rolls-Royce expands CorporateCare Enhanced coverage without raising hourly rate
en.summary: Rolls-Royce adds minor-damage and return-shipping coverage without increasing the program's hourly rate.
body: Rolls-Royce says CorporateCare Enhanced, its business-jet engine maintenance program, will add coverage for minor foreign-object damage, parts return shipping and other costs. The additions were announced at NBAA-BACE 2026 in Las Vegas and will not increase the program’s hourly rate. Customers pay into the program according to the hours they fly, spreading the cost of covered engine maintenance over time rather than paying large bills when work is needed.

Coverage for minor foreign-object damage applies when damage does not require immediate engine or nacelle removal and can be repaired on-wing or near-wing. Major foreign-object damage remains excluded, with claims continuing to go through insurance. For eligible Pearl engine customers, the program will also cover life-limited parts when they reach their prescribed time limits. Rolls-Royce will pay return shipping costs and is developing a process with prepaid labels.

zh.title: 俄羅斯Su-30戰機加里寧格勒墜毀 機組員彈射獲救
zh.summary: 俄羅斯國防部證實Su-30戰機訓練墜毀，機組員彈射獲救
body: 俄羅斯國防部證實，一架俄羅斯Sukhoi Su-30戰機於2026年10月21日在加里寧格勒地區執行預定訓練飛行時墜毀。國防部表示，機組員已彈射，並由地面搜救隊尋獲；該部稱飛行員生命無虞。
另有俄羅斯媒體援引未具名消息人士報導，涉事機型為Su-30SM，兩名飛行員受傷。這項機型辨識及傷情說法，均由媒體歸於未具名消息人士。

en.title: Russian Su-30 crashes during training in Kaliningrad, crew ejects
en.summary: Russia confirms a Su-30 crash during training in Kaliningrad; crew ejected and was recovered.
body: The Russian Ministry of Defense confirmed that a Russian Sukhoi Su-30 fighter crashed in the Kaliningrad region on October 21, 2026, during a scheduled training flight. The ministry said the crew ejected and was recovered by a ground search and rescue team, and that the pilots’ lives were not in danger.

Separately, Russian media outlets citing unnamed sources identified the aircraft as a Su-30SM and reported that both pilots were injured. The variant identification and injury claim were attributed to those unnamed sources.

zh.title: 日本航空已在九座機場取消未來數日航班
zh.summary: 日本航空已在九座機場取消航班，影響未來數日
body: Simple Flying報導，日本航空已在九座機場取消航班，相關調整涵蓋未來數日。報導標題將航班削減與颱風Champi對亞洲樞紐的威脅並列，並稱軍事航空也受到影響。
報導摘要所述的日本航空措施為航班取消，涉及九座機場，時間範圍為未來數日。現有資訊沒有列出受影響機場名稱、航班班次或確切日期，因此不宜進一步推定哪些航班受到影響。

en.title: Japan Airlines Cancels Flights at Nine Airports in Coming Days
en.summary: Japan Airlines has cancelled flights at nine airports over the coming days.
body: Simple Flying reports that Japan Airlines has already cancelled flights at nine airports over the coming days. Its headline frames the flight cuts amid Typhoon Champi’s threat to Asian hubs and says military aviation is also affected.

The stated action for Japan Airlines is flight cancellation, with nine airports affected over the coming days. The report summary does not identify the airports, flight numbers, or specific dates, so the scope of the airline’s cancellations cannot be specified beyond those details.
